card.name: Inside foreign names in old texts
card.fires_on: Partway through unusual transliterated foreign names, such as place names, personal names and book titles, in historical or encyclopedic prose. It also fires on 'of' after a title like Emperor or after 'natives'.

modes.label: Inside transliterated names
modes.description: A middle piece of a long, unfamiliar foreign personal or place name, often with hyphens.
modes.example: Memoirs of Zehir-Ed<<-D>>in Muhammed Baber: Emperor

modes.label: 'of' after a title or group
modes.description: The word 'of' after a title or a group noun, before a place or church name.
modes.example: Memoirs of Zehir-Ed-Din Muhammed Baber: emperor<< of>> Hindustan.

card.plain: It marks the middle of strange foreign names in old historical writing, where the name is not finished yet.
